messages:
Maya: Quick sync — I'm putting together a 90-day incident heatmap and follow-up tracker. Goal: identify the top recurring causes and lock down owners + realistic ETAs for remediation. Sharing highlights and action items below.

Sam: Thanks Maya. Can you drop the heatmap link?

Maya: https://redwood.internal/heatmaps/90d — summary:
- 38%: downstream rate-limit spikes causing request queues to balloon -> cascading timeouts
- 24%: config drift on autoscaler thresholds (two separate clusters)
- 18%: canary rollback miscoordination during deploys -> double-serving old+new models
- 12%: KV cache eviction storms after GC window -> elevated p99 latency
- 8%: third-party auth token expiry edge-case

Lin: Solid. For the follow-ups, can we list the top actions and mark owners + due dates? Some items are >30d overdue.

Maya: Proposed action items (brief):
```
1) Rate-limit backpressure handling: add graceful throttling + circuit-breaker, and add busy metrics to alerting.  Owner: Alex. ETA: 2026-06-03
2) Autoscaler config audit + templating: detect drift and auto-remediate via infra pipeline.  Owner: Sam. ETA: 2026-05-28
3) Canary deployment guardrails: add pre-rollout KV lock + canary traffic split sanity checks. Owner: Maya. ETA: 2026-06-10
4) KV cache tuning + eviction smoothing: introduce jittered TTLs and backoff. Owner: Alex. ETA: 2026-06-15
5) Auth token refresh hardening + fallback: ensure token refresh is retried with exponential backoff. Owner: Lin. ETA: 2026-05-30
```

Alex: I'll take 1 & 4. Quick question: for (1) do we want a local in-process token bucket or a global quota per customer?

Maya: Start with per-host graceful token bucket to stop immediate queuing, then follow with global quota as phase 2. Put phase 2 on roadmap after we see host-level reduction.

Sam: For (2) I'll run the autoscaler audit this week. Will create a PR to add a CI check to fail deploys when drift detected. ETA still 2026-05-28 unless blocked.

Lin: I'll own (5). I'll check current auth library, file a small PR to increase refresh retries + metrics. Also will add an integration test to simulate expiry. ETA 2026-05-30.

Maya: For (3) I'll implement the canary lock and add an SLO check that prevents overlapping model versions serving. Also will add a playbook snippet to the runbook.

PagerBot: Incident follow-up created: INC-2026-1187-FOLLOWUP assigned -> Maya, due 2026-06-10.

Sam: One more ask: can we triage which incidents are regressions vs. new root causes? If regression, we should escalate to the owning team and consider postmortem update.

Maya: Good point. I'll add a "regression?" column in the tracker and tag postmortems that need updates.

Alex: Timeline + blockers: I might need infra quota from cloud team to test global quota (phase 2). @Sam can you help unblock if I file a ticket?

Sam: Yea, ping me the ticket ID. I'll prioritize with infra.

Lin: Suggestion — let's run a short monthly recurring audit meeting for this heatmap (30m). Keep action items small and measurable. Does Wednesday afternoons work?

Maya: Works for me. Scheduling a recurring: first session 2026-05-21 15:00 PT. I'll post invite.

Sam: +1. Also propose we add a small "incident economics" metric to the tracker: avg cost per incident (tokens + infra) — helps prioritize fixes.

Maya: Agree. Adding a column for "estimated monthly cost".

Alex: I'll open PRs for items 1 & 4 by EOD Monday.

Maya: Thanks — I'll assemble the tracker CSV and post to #incidents + attach to the affected postmortems.

Sam: Can we use labels on PMs so the follow-ups show up in the roadmap?

Maya: Yep — will tag with `followup/infra` and `followup/deploy` accordingly.

Lin: Quick note: two older postmortems (INC-2026-1102, INC-2026-1129) still show "owner: unassigned" in the follow-up doc. I'll take INC-1102 for now and assign INC-1129 to devtools next sprint.

Maya: Updated tracker with assignments and estimated costs. Posting link: https://redwood.internal/trackers/incidents-90d.csv

Alex: :thumbsup: I'll reference the tracker in my PRs.

PagerBot: Reminder scheduled: /remind #incidents to review heatmap every month on the third Wednesday at 09:00.

Maya: Closing actionables for this thread: owners to update PRs/tickets and mark status in the tracker by their ETAs. If you're blocked, ping here with ticket ID.

Sam: Ack.

Alex: Ack — will update by 2026-06-03.

Lin: Ack — will update by 2026-05-30.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll post a short summary in the all-hands weekly with the high-level top causes and remediation plan.

Sam: Thanks — great coordination.
